role: 'Delete All My Data' orchestrator: refuses while a recording is under way or a reading is waiting to be accepted, otherwise awaits CloudKit zone deletion, sweeps every file in App Group/Application Support/Documents/Caches/tmp and every UserDefaults key (minus keep-lists), then resets named stores (archive dirs, keychain, AI stores, settings, breadcrumbs, caches, notifications) and returns a localized Report. The stores it clears beyond its named parameters come from the Stores set its caller passes (AppDependencies.purgeStores in the app), never from AppDependencies.current.
types: DataPurgeService.Report: struct — per-step booleans (profileReset among them), residual counts, errors, localized text
DataPurgeService.Refusal: enum (Error, LocalizedError) — why a purge did not run or stopped before the local wipe: recordingInProgress, recordingStartedDuringDelete
DataPurgeService.ReadBack: struct — the outcomes read back from the stores after the steps
DataPurgeService.PurgeScope: struct (@MainActor) — where a purge sweeps files and preferences: App Group container, sandbox roots, preference suites; .device in production

DataPurgeService.Stores: struct (extension) — resolvers for every service the purge clears or reads back beyond the named parameters: recorderBox plus the Assistant, Location (trails, routes, ambient location, road geocoding, weather, nearby places) and Device groups (nested structs), built by AppDependencies.purgeStores
toplevel: Entries are purgeAllUserData and isRecordingInProgress, called by DeleteAllDataPage.swift and DataPurgeServiceTests (which also calls purgeRoots). The preferences sweep (sweepAllDefaults, deviceDefaultsDomains and the keep rules, which remove the legacy widget.* keys an earlier build wrote to the App Group suite: none is kept) is in DataPurgeService+Defaults.swift. An extension at the end declares DataPurgeService.Stores and its Assistant, Location and Device groups (resolver closures only, no logic).

units.does: Localized explanation of a refusal. .recordingInProgress: stop the recording in progress, or accept or discard the reading that is waiting for review, first, because otherwise its data would be saved again after the delete. .recordingStartedDuringDelete: a recording started while the data was being deleted, so nothing on this device was deleted; iCloud sync is now off; stop the recording and run Delete All My Data again.
units.entry: LocalizedError.localizedDescription, read by DeleteAllDataPage.recordingFooter and by the catch in DeleteAllDataPage.runPurge

units.does: True when the collector passed is recording or holds a reading waiting to be accepted (collectorIsRecording), or the workout recorder passed is recording (workoutIsRecording); false when neither is, or both are nil.
units.entry: DeleteAllDataPage.recordingInProgress; appIsRecording (the default recording check in purgeAllUserData); DataPurgeServiceTests

units.does: True while the collector's isCollecting, isOvernightStreaming, isPaused, isRecordingOnDevice or needsAcceptance is set, or its recordingPhase is anything but .idle: .streaming, .overnightStreaming, .deviceRecording, .paused, .analyzing or .awaitingAcceptance (a quick reading, a night including a paused one or a stopped one being analysed, a strap recording, or a reading waiting to be accepted or discarded). False only for .idle with none of the flags set.
True while the workout's phase is .recording (a paused workout keeps that phase) or .finalizing; false for .idle, .finished and .failed.
The running app's recording answer: isRecordingInProgress over RRCollector.current and the workout recorder held by the RecorderBox that `recorderBox` resolves.

First asks whether a recording is under way or a reading is waiting to be accepted (recordingInProgress when passed, else appIsRecording over RRCollector.current and the workout recorder in stores.recorderBox) and, if one is, throws Refusal.recordingInProgress before anything is deleted, iCloud included. Otherwise closes PurgeGate for the whole purge (beginPurge waits for the archive writes already in flight; endPurge on every exit), so every archive write and CloudKit upload or full sync is refused while it runs; turns iCloud sync off; then awaits the remote CloudKit deletion. Asks about a recording again: one started during that wait throws Refusal.recordingStartedDuringDelete and nothing on the device is wiped. Otherwise runs the local purge: container file sweep (keeping only the live settings file, settingsManager.settingsURL) + in-memory archive reset, UserDefaults sweep, named directory/store resets, a reset of the personal baseline tracker (the one passed, else RRCollector.current's), debug/crash log purge, then reads the settings file back (readBackProfile) and every other store whose clear reports no failure (readBackClearedStores) and returns the Report built from those results (report). The file and preference sweeps and the archive/backup directory resets run in `scope` (default .device, the app's own containers and suites; tests pass temporary ones); settings and CloudKit local state are the instances passed by name, and every other store the steps clear or read back (keychain, assistant stores, breadcrumbs, routes, location caches, logs, workout track backups, notifications) is the one `stores` resolves.

branches.effect: throws Refusal.recordingStartedDuringDelete; iCloud sync stays off, the remote deletion has run, the device is not wiped; the gate opens

units.does: Builds the Report from each step's result: the remote outcome, the archive/backup/keychain results, the read-back stores, the profile read-back, the log steps, the residual file and key counts and the errors.

After all purge steps, checks each store (the conversation, facts, assistant view model and breadcrumb stores are the ones `stores` resolves) the report would otherwise assume cleared: CloudKit lastSyncDate nil and zoneCreated false; the conversation history file empty or gone and no summary file once the store's queued clear has run (ConversationStore.isEmptyOnDisk — a remaining set-aside copy, a folder that cannot be listed, a summary file, or a history file that is unreadable or undecodable, counts as not cleared); UserFactsStore.facts empty and the facts file holding no facts once its queued write has run (persistedFacts); SettingsManager.hasAcceptedDisclaimer false; the assistant disclaimer false in UserDefaults and in the view model; UnitsPreferenceStore.current == .auto; and no breadcrumb active.json or archive.json (checked on the store's queue, after its pending clear/erase).
UserSettings() with iCloudSyncEnabled = false: the settings purgeLocalStores leaves, which readBackProfile expects on disk.

The Profile step: asks the settings manager to flush its pending write and compare the file with purgedSettings (flushedFileHolds). Returns true when the file holds them; otherwise appends a localized 'Profile: ...' error (the saved settings still hold an earlier profile, or the write/read/decode error) and returns false.

branches.effect: error 'Profile: the saved settings still hold an earlier profile', false

branches.cond: flush write, read or decode threw

units.does: On the stores `stores` resolves: purges workout GPS backups, resets CloudKit local sync state, removes all API keys from the Keychain, clears the assistant conversation (view model and store: the history file, its set-aside copies and the summary file, synchronously) and user facts, resets settings to defaults with iCloud sync OFF, removes ud AssistantViewModel.disclaimerKey (assistant.disclaimerAccepted), sets units to .auto, clears breadcrumb active trail and archive, and resets in-memory location/contact/artifact stores, the display and training-load caches, and AI consents. Returns whether keychain removal fully succeeded.
Cancels scheduled morning notifications on the MorningNotificationScheduler `scheduler` resolves and removes all delivered notifications.

On the stores `stores` resolves: disengages the ActiveRouteSession (memory-only turn-by-turn route), then calls forgetAfterPurge on SavedRouteStore, BreadcrumbRecorder, AmbientLocationService, RoadGeocodingService (road context and its coordinate), WeatherService (snapshot, forecast and its coordinate), SurroundingsPOIService (nearby-places cache), EmailContactStore, AssistantArtifactStore, UIStateCache and TrainingMetricsCache, then revokes assistant agreements.
Revokes consent for every provider requiring it on the ProviderConsentTracker the Assistant group resolves and sets that group's assistant view model's hasAcceptedDisclaimer false.
writes: ud:ProviderConsentTracker storageKey/grantedAt keys per provider (removed, ProviderConsentTracker.swift)

units.does: Clears the debug logger `logger` resolves (memory, pending lines, and its file removed synchronously on the logger queue; the result is ignored), then deletes debug_log.txt at the logger's own path (AppConfig.sharedContainerURL(), App Group or its Documents fallback) if it is still present — the log re-created by logging during the purge; returns false and records an error only if that deletion throws.
Clears the crash logs of the CrashLogManager `crashLogs` resolves; on throw records 'Crash logs: <error>' and returns false.

On the stores `stores` resolves, clears the heat-acclimation cache (HeatAcclimationCache.clear(): persisted readout and legacy coordinates, the in-memory readout and any refresh in flight), LLM cache telemetry, LLM request audit, SleepDataCache, RespiratoryBaselineCache, WristTemperatureBaselineCache and the recovery-score feedback store; a feedback log that cannot be removed appends 'Recovery score feedback: <error>'.
